title: My stats
subtitle: Your games, your champions, your roles.
emptyRoster: This team has no players yet.
footnote: No global average is shown here: it is not available, and inventing one would be worse than doing without. Every figure is compared to your own other games or to your teammates.

locked.title: Link a Riot account to open this screen
locked.description: With no linked account there is nothing to compute: statistics are built from your games, and nothing tells us which ones are yours.

pending.title: Your Riot ID is waiting to be confirmed
pending.description: It is saved, but we could not confirm it with Riot yet. Collection will start as soon as we can.

waiting.title: Your data is on its way
waiting.description: The first pass walks your whole history. It is slow once, and only once.

window.label: Period
window.helper: Every figure on this screen covers that period.
window.bounded: Riot keeps about a thousand games per player: beyond that the history no longer exists, for anyone.

coverage.untracked: This account is not collected for itself yet: the known games are those where it met a player we track. The figures are exact, but partial.

delta.versusRest: {{delta}} against the rest of their pool ({{count}} game(s))

section.queuesHelper: Queues are counted separately: a win in normal draft is not a win in flex.
section.byQueueHelper: The queue excludes nothing: it separates what cannot be compared.
section.presenceHelper: Share of team games each player took part in.
section.trendHelper: Your win rate month by month, against your own average.
section.trendReference: Line: your average over the period ({{value}})
section.noMonth: Not enough history yet to draw a trend.

team.definition: A team game: at least {{count}} of the {{roster}} players on the roster, across all queues.
team.gamesHint: {{total}} found, {{undecided}} of them without a shared result
team.truncated: Only the most recent games are shown: the totals cover what is visible here.

COMPTE_RIOT_ABSENT.short: No Riot account linked: nothing to compute.
COMPTE_RIOT_ABSENT.title: No Riot account linked
COMPTE_RIOT_ABSENT.description: Statistics are built from an account's games. Until a Riot ID is set, there are no games to attach.

INGESTION_EN_COURS.title: Collection is not finished
INGESTION_EN_COURS.description: The history is still being built. It is slow once, and only once: figures will appear as it goes.

AUCUNE_PARTIE.title: No game
AUCUNE_PARTIE.description: Everything is collected and there is nothing to count over this period. That is not a failure: widen the period to look further back.

EFFECTIF_INCOMPLET.title: Not enough Riot accounts on the roster
EFFECTIF_INCOMPLET.description: A team game needs at least four players present. While fewer than four members have a linked Riot account, no game can be recognised as a team game.

CONNECTEUR_INDISPONIBLE.title: Figures unavailable
CONNECTEUR_INDISPONIBLE.description: The Riot connector is not answering. Nothing is lost — but while it is silent we cannot claim anything, and showing zero would be wrong.
